name: seo_domain_ranked_keywords
description: What keywords does `<domain>` rank for — returns the keywords a domain ranks for in Google organic, with search volume, current rank, and ranking URL. Competitor SEO intelligence. Example: seo_domain_ranked_keywords({ target: "nike.com", location_code: 2840, limit: 50, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account
